title: Amazonian tribesmen identify a grey as Makunwabu
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Amazonian tribesmen identify a grey as Makunwabu, about a few years ago at Amazon basin, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They found an alien gray and they showed this alien gray and the Amazonian tribe and went that's Makunwabu.

plain: A guest named Jay Anderson, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells a story he heard about people in the Amazon. He says someone showed a tribe an image of a "grey", the classic alien with a small grey body and a large head, and the tribe recognised it at once, calling it Makunwabu. If true, it would suggest these beings are known to cultures that never saw modern alien pictures.
